Yes on all three:

1. Seated capacity is 40 — right at your headcount, so it'll be a full room.
2. AV includes a projector, 2 wireless mics, and a Sonos sound system, all included in the rate.
3. In-house catering runs $35–$65 per person, depending on the menu.

For a Tuesday, you'd be looking at the weekday rate: $180/hour with a 4-hour minimum. Most weekdays in October are open — do you have a specific date in mind so I can check availability?
